headline: Is he ever going to be ready for real commitment?
note:
🔄 REWRITTEN 2026-08-19 to the Natural Tarot-Cut framework. Bubbles 3-6 run as ONE causal chain — so / and / but / that's why — and the read ANSWERS. The art line and the bridge are unchanged. Every ban in this note still stands.

On the two Magician/Hanged Man/Fool decks — one set of copy, verb swapped ('turned' face-down, 'chose' face-up).

🔴 THESE ASK FOR A PREDICTION OUTRIGHT, which is the exact thing the funnel forbids, so the no-verdict rule runs in BOTH directions plus a no-timeframe rule: 'he will, give it time' reads as a promise and 'he never will' is a pronouncement on a man she loves. 🔴 The bans in tests/tarot-commitment-copy.test.ts are WHOLE-BEAT rather than clause-level, so 'not enough' and 'too much' are unavailable even inside a refusal — the usual absolution form had to be rebuilt without them.

Finding: the GAP between what SHE is ready for and where HE is standing is real information — and her readiness is legitimate rather than impatience. Kept deliberately distinct from cards-twin-ready, which is its measured pair in tests/tarot-twin-flame-copy.test.ts and may share no 6-word run with it.

a: You turned the Magician, dear. Look — the table hides him from the waist down.
You asked if he will be ready for real commitment. Your hand went to the man who builds.
So he will get there, dear. This card is a man who builds things.
And the making of it is already in his hands, dear.
But the table hides him from the waist down. You can't see his footing.
That's why he can talk about a future, dear. He never steps toward it.
Let me look closer at what sits in the gap between you…
b: You turned the Hanged Man, dear. Look — one shoe points down, and the other points out sideways.
You asked if he will be ready for real commitment. Your hand went to the card that stops the clock.
So he has stopped in one spot, dear. Stopped is not finished.
And look at his feet. One shoe points down, one points off sideways.
But I won't name a day for you, dear. There's no day on this card.
That's why it stalls at the very same place, dear, every single time.
Let me look closer at what keeps stopping this at the same spot…
c: You turned the Fool, dear. Look — a small circle floats above him, next to a big bright sun.
You asked if he will be ready for real commitment. Your hand went to the one who hasn't chosen.
So nothing has been chosen yet, dear. Nothing has been ruled out either.
And he's stepping out with no one thing in mind, dear.
But you know exactly what you're ready for. That's the difference here.
That's why you wait for him to catch up, dear. You got there first.
Let me look closer at what stands between you and a real choice…
